description: This file defines structures and classes related to DWARF Frame Description Entries (FDE) used in stack unwinding, including parsing and instruction interpretation for unwinding operations in the torch::unwind namespace.

classes.name: TableState
classes.description: Represents the state of the unwinding table, including the current CFA and register actions.

classes.name: FDE
classes.description: Template class for parsing and interpreting Frame Description Entries (FDE) in DWARF unwinding, with methods for instruction execution and state management.

methods.name: advance_raw
methods.description: Advances the current program counter by a specified amount, optionally logging the operation.

methods.name: advance_loc
methods.description: Advances the location based on the code alignment factor, with optional logging.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Sets a register to an offset from the CFA, with optional logging.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a register to its initial state, with optional logging.

methods.name: def_cfa
methods.description: Defines the Canonical Frame Address (CFA) based on a register and offset, with optional logging.

methods.name: def_cfa_register
methods.description: Defines the CFA using the last used register and offset.

methods.name: def_cfa_offset
methods.description: Defines the CFA with the last used register and a new offset.

methods.name: remember_state
methods.description: Saves the current unwinding state onto the stack.

methods.name: restore_state
methods.description: Restores the unwinding state from the top of the stack.

methods.name: register_
methods.description: Associates a register with another register.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current unwinding table state.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the FDE details and current state for debugging.

methods.name: readUpTo
methods.description: Parses instructions up to a specified address to determine the unwinding state.

methods.name: dumpAddr2Line
methods.description: Outputs a command for addr2line to map addresses to source lines.

methods.name: readInstruction
methods.description: Reads and executes a single DWARF instruction from the provided lexer.

methods.name: hasAugmentation
methods.description: Checks if the augmentation string contains a specific substring.
